category control the style of callout numbers inside verbatim blocks and in callout lists.
The bundled font used by the default theme for conums (M+ 1mn) only supports callout numbers 1-20. If you need more callout numbers, you must specify the

key to remap the callout numbers to Unicode value using Unicode escape ranges. Keep in mind that the font you specify must provide the glyphs for these Unicode values or else the callout number won’t be rendered.
